records.title: DIGITAL PERSONAL DATA PROTECTION ACT 2023.
details: a to d: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology ('MeitY) has initiated the process of drafting Rulesin accordance with the DPDP Act. The formation of the Data Protection Board is a subsequent step after the notification of the Rules under DPDP Act.

records.title: Status of Establishment of Kendriya Vidyalaya at Jeypore, Odisha
details: Part (a) to (d) : As per information received from Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan (KVS), a proposal for establishment of a new KV at Jeypore, District Koraput has been received. The proposals received from the sponsoring authorities for opening of new KVs are in varying stages of being examined / processed at various levels and are subject to approval of the competent authority.
